entities.name: Hashaton
entities.description: A legendary zombie wizard of Amonkhet, eternalized in lazotep plating, who serves the Scarab God.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: Deity of Amonkhet whom Hashaton has followed since before Bolas warped the God's form.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who warped the Scarab God's form.

events.summary: Bolas warped the Scarab God's form, long after Hashaton began serving the God.
